data.one_liner: Speed dial floating action button widget that animates multiple action buttons.
data.what_it_does: Provides an ExpandableFab widget that displays multiple action buttons in a fan, vertical, or horizontal layout with enter/exit animations and custom builders.
use_when: You need a speed dial menu attached to a FloatingActionButton
You want to animate multiple action buttons displaying and hiding in various layout styles
avoid_when: Your app uses package:flutter/material.dart and you cannot migrate to material_ui in version 3.0.0
strengths: Supports vertical, horizontal, and fan-shaped layouts
Allows custom button builders and non-FAB widgets in the action list
Includes overlay style options with color and blur
weaknesses: Version 3.0.0 introduces a breaking migration from flutter/material to material_ui
data.setup_notes: Requires migrating to material_ui as of version 3.0.0.
data.minimal_example:
Scaffold(
  floatingActionButtonLocation: ExpandableFab.location,
  floatingActionButton: ExpandableFab(
    children: [
      FloatingActionButton.small(
        heroTag: null,
        child: const Icon(Icons.edit),
        onPressed: () {},
      ),
      FloatingActionButton.small(
        heroTag: null,
        child: const Icon(Icons.search),
        onPressed: () {},
      ),
    ],
  ),
),
